payload.reason: The evidence provides specific information about state-of-the-art baselines in the context of text-to-SQL generation, including details about the models used for comparison.

claims.text: State-of-the-art baselines include Context-dependent Seq2Seq (CD-Seq2Seq) and SyntaxSQL-con models.
CD-Seq2Seq is adapted for context-dependent SQL generation by incorporating a bi-LSTM database schema encoder.
SyntaxSQL-con uses bi-LSTMs and a column attention mechanism to enhance SQL query generation.
